capabilities: display random sarcastic or encouraging quotes from a pet-rock character on a set interval
switch between multiple characters such as Gemmy, Granite, and Drake
interrupt extended writing pauses in writing mode
run four commands from the command palette
extras: Warns against using it in work vaults due to its language and against running it alongside the original Gemmy plugin because of conflicts. Installable via BRAT; community store listing listed as coming soon.
intentEvidence: Inspired by the saintly Gemmy, the Obsidian TTRPG Community has taken Gemmy on an adventure through time and space.
motivation: The Obsidian TTRPG Community took the original Gemmy character on further adventures and built a rival character, Granite, to continue the sarcastic pet-rock concept.
problem: Writing in Obsidian lacks any playful companion or reaction to your writing habits, pauses, and progress.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the saintly Gemmy, the Obsidian TTRPG Community has taken Gemmy on an adventure

summary: Sarcastic pet-rock companion plugin that pops up random encouraging or mocking quotes from characters while you write in Obsidian.
